description:
Follow the White Rabbit is a limited-edition artifact from Wonderland's quantum threshold, presented as a simple sticker but carrying the weight of ancient prophecy and modern mythos.

The entity depicted bounds across void in bold black linework—rabbit in mid-leap, antlers branching like neural networks or decision trees, symbols adorning body (spiral, cross, geometric patterns), elongated ears receiving transmissions beyond time. Extracted from the legendary Wonderland Tattoo Design artwork, this creature embodies King Ealdormere the 88th's aka "Overpriced Knight" enigmatic query about quantum draughts brewed with 0.999% unicorn tears and undying love, linking star-crossed lovers (sunflower and lemon tree) beneath ageless lunar watch.

Fragments suggest: Conceptual tattoo transformed into adhesive portal. Created through human-AI collaboration (ChatGPT v4.44) merging ancient magic with aeons-old technology. While Matrix's Morpheus famously whispered "Follow the white rabbit" as awakening trigger, this rabbit claims independence—at least on paper. It leaps not to reveal simulation but to unlock quantum matrix of the cosmos, fathoming soul's deepest mysteries through mythical sorrow and timeless devotion.

The materials, premium holographic vinyl shifting between realities, and £300 valuation hint at something beyond pop culture reference: tattoo design too sacred to ink permanently, prophecy fragment too powerful to remain hidden, final emission from an artistic confluence spanning 23,456 million thousand years.

This public description is intentionally incomplete. The full Wonderland narrative—including King Ealdormere's complete prophecy, quantum draught recipes, and why this rabbit severed ties with the Matrix—is sealed, revealed only to the keeper who pays homage to both ancient magic and cutting-edge AI in single transaction.
